context: A rooming house on E 41st St. Ida Lorne, ankle in plaster, by the window.

lines.speaker: char.ida_lorne
lines.text: Walter sent you? Walter doesn't send people. Walter answers questions.

lines.speaker: char.ida_lorne
lines.text: Broken ankle. Six weeks of stairs I can't do. Tell him the ankle, not the age.

lines.speaker: char.ida_lorne
lines.text: Better: stand in my corner Thursday and say it for me. You'll do it badly. Good.
